O.outcome_detail: acquisition of new technological skills during online study

cells.quote: As we see in Fig. 1, students from all areas of knowledge acquired new technologi- cal skills.
cells.note: The study reports acquisition across all knowledge areas but does not provide a specific between-area effect or a formal comparison test.
